svg.title: Awesome μP
svg.desc: Papers, code and notes on μP and μTransfer. Training loss versus log2 learning rate for widths 256 to 8192. Under μP every curve reaches its minimum at the same learning rate, and wider models reach lower loss.

g.text: same optimal learning rate at every width
